My Strava Journey · Seven years on foot, read as data

2,068 outings and 13,255 km on foot over seven years, most of them in Tanzania. My Strava log read as data: maps, records, tested habits and a free book.

  • Year in Sport: Every year of my log as its own report, from 27 outings in 2019 to 330 in 2026 so far.
  • Sports: My four sports on foot: 9,132 km of running and 4,012 km of walking, with trail runs and hikes, and the treadmill kept apart from the road.
  • Records: My longest, highest and hardest days on foot: 42.7 km in one outing, 1,979 m of climbing in one outing, and 308 days in a row.
  • Where: Where I go out: five African countries and 17 regions of Tanzania, mapped from where each outing started.
  • Timeline: Seven years in the order they happened: milestones, firsts on foot, trips, streaks and breaks.
  • Goals: The same three targets held against every year: 1,000 km of walking, 1,000 km of running and 24,000 m of climbing on foot.
  • What It Means: What seven years of logging taught me about keeping a habit, in my own words, with the numbers behind each lesson.
  • The Habit on Trial: Twelve things I believe about my habit, tested with statistics against the log: seven proven, three supported and two not proven.
  • My Book: Showing Up, the whole story as a free book, with every chart drawn from the log up to 1 November 2026. Read it online or download the PDF.
